hook.what: A verbatim line that states the stakes in the first seconds and makes sense with zero context. 5 = a hot take / claim a stranger would stop for; 3 = clear topic setup, no tension; 1 = needs the previous minute to make sense.

payoff.what: The closing line ANSWERS the hook. 5 = a verdict, number or decision that closes the loop exactly; 3 = a conclusion on the topic but not the hook's question; 1 = trails off or changes subject.

story.what: One through-line that escalates: setup -> turns (new fact, disagreement, example, laugh) roughly every 60-90 s -> payoff. No stretch that only repeats. 5 = every range moves it forward; 3 = one soft stretch; 1 = a topic, not a story.

package.what: CTR lives here: can the title + one thumbnail image sell it? Named product / person / price / conflict, a curiosity gap the clip really closes, a face (Colden's for his channel). 5 = title and thumbnail are obvious and specific; 3 = workable; 1 = only a vague topic.

channel_fit.what: Matches a lane the channel data shows working (views, 7-day views, % viewed, kept at 30 s, subs gained, search terms). Score >= 3 must cite video ids from data/channels/*/videos.json.

platform.what: Recent videos on the same topic beat their own channel's normal (evidence.py). Score >= 3 must cite video ids found by evidence.py; score >= 4 needs at least one cited video at 2x its channel median or better.

timeliness.what: News, new releases, rumors (Colden 2026-10-01: 'always gets priority'). 5 = this week's news / a launch or rumor still unfolding; 3 = recent and still discussed; 1 = evergreen. Score >= 4 needs news.date + news.source_url and ranks the theme ahead of every non-news theme.

self_contained.what: A viewer who never saw the episode misses nothing: no 'like we said earlier', no unexplained name, every thing pointed at is shown. Capped by the cold-read reviewer's score.

footage.what: The picture holds up: presentable cameras, the screen share / played clip that the talk points at exists as a file, no long stretch of one static shot.

length.rule: Colden 2026-10-01: no hard rule. Target 8:00 counting cold open + stinger + end screen (mid-roll). Shorter is fine - never pad. 10-15 min is fine when it concludes much stronger. Outside 5-10 min the theme carries a length_note saying why the story needs that length; under 3 or over 15 is asked.

soft_rule: Colden 2026-10-01 (after the Ep 24 run, a no-news episode where nothing reached 70): "you can soften scoring and send the best themes. most will be for TCL but I would like something going on my channel." -> when fewer than 3 themes reach the pass line, themes from soft_pass up are delivered too (best first, 5 at most), marked SOFT PASS on the card; the floors and the cold read still apply. Each card carries a suggested channel; at least one theme is suggested for Colden's own channel.
hook_max_note: ruling 32 (Colden 2026-10-01, "could easily condense to 12-15s"): the cold open is 15 s at most in the EDIT (edit.json cold_open_max), and the edit adds 0.4 s of lead / tail - so a theme's hook phrases may run 14.5 s. A longer line needs `cold_open_waiver` (his words) on the theme, at the theme stage.
